Mark tag with no highlight style strips the mark

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<p>Text with <mark>plain</mark> content.</p>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(highlight_style: 'None'))
puts result.content.inspect
```
